description: Engineering signal processing decomposed. DFT/FFT, windowing, spectral leakage, FIR/IIR design, anti-aliasing, oversampling, decimation, wavelets, time-frequency analysis (STFT, spectrogram).

sub_mechanisms.name: DFT_FFT
sub_mechanisms.definition: Discrete Fourier Transform: N-point spectrum from N samples. FFT: O(N log N) algorithm.
sub_mechanisms.why: Cooley-Tukey 1965. Foundation of digital spectral analysis. Speech, vibration, communications. Universal.

sub_mechanisms.name: windowing_spectral_leakage
sub_mechanisms.definition: Finite-length sample = multiplication by rectangular window. Spectrum convolved with sinc → leakage.
sub_mechanisms.why: Apparent energy in adjacent bins. Mitigations: Hanning, Hamming, Blackman windows. Trade: mainlobe width vs sidelobe attenuation.

sub_mechanisms.name: FIR_filter
sub_mechanisms.definition: Finite Impulse Response. y[n] = Σ b_k × x[n-k]. Always stable; linear phase possible.
sub_mechanisms.why: Audio, communications. Predictable phase (no group delay distortion). Cost: many taps for sharp transitions.

sub_mechanisms.name: IIR_filter
sub_mechanisms.definition: Infinite Impulse Response. y[n] = Σ b_k × x[n-k] - Σ a_k × y[n-k]. Recursive.
sub_mechanisms.why: Sharp filters with few coefficients. Cost: nonlinear phase, can be unstable. Used where computation tight + linear phase not needed.

sub_mechanisms.name: Butterworth_filter
sub_mechanisms.definition: Maximally flat passband. No ripple. Smooth rolloff.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard analog + digital filter. Compromise between sharpness + phase response. Default choice when unsure.

sub_mechanisms.name: Chebyshev_filter
sub_mechanisms.definition: Ripple in passband (Type I) or stopband (Type II). Sharper transition than Butterworth.
sub_mechanisms.why: Steeper rolloff for same order. Trade: passband ripple. Used where sharp cutoff matters.

sub_mechanisms.name: elliptic_Cauer_filter
sub_mechanisms.definition: Ripple in both passband + stopband. Sharpest transition possible.
sub_mechanisms.why: Minimum order for given specifications. Cost: ripples + nonlinear phase. Used in critical applications.

sub_mechanisms.name: anti_aliasing_filter
sub_mechanisms.definition: Analog filter before ADC. Cutoff < Nyquist frequency.
sub_mechanisms.why: Removes above-Nyquist signals to prevent aliasing. Always required for sampling. Analog (not digital) since must precede ADC.

sub_mechanisms.name: oversampling_sigma_delta
sub_mechanisms.definition: ADC at high rate + decimate. Σ-Δ converters use feedback to noise-shape.
sub_mechanisms.why: Audio ADCs: 1-bit at MHz, decimated to 24-bit at 96 kHz. Anti-aliasing simpler. Modern standard.

sub_mechanisms.name: decimation_interpolation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Decimation: low-pass + downsample. Interpolation: upsample + low-pass.
sub_mechanisms.why: Sample rate conversion. Always-needed in mixed-rate systems. Polyphase implementations efficient.

sub_mechanisms.name: STFT_spectrogram
sub_mechanisms.definition: Short-Time Fourier Transform. FFT on overlapping windows. Time-frequency representation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Speech, music, vibration analysis. Trade-off: window length = time vs frequency resolution. Foundation of audio analysis.

sub_mechanisms.name: wavelet_transform
sub_mechanisms.definition: Decompose into wavelets (localised in time + frequency). Multiresolution.
sub_mechanisms.why: Better than STFT for transient detection. Used in compression (JPEG 2000), denoising. Multiple bases.

derivation_rules.name: FIR_chosen_for_linear_phase
derivation_rules.why: Linear phase: all frequencies delayed equally. No phase distortion. Audio, image processing. FIR achievable; IIR can't (Butterworth has zero phase only as analog).

derivation_rules.name: windowing_required_for_finite_samples
if: spectrum computed from finite signal segment
derivation_rules.why: Rectangular window: sinc spectrum, high leakage. Hanning: lower leakage. Foundation of practical spectral analysis.

derivation_rules.name: anti_aliasing_required_before_sampling
derivation_rules.why: Above Nyquist aliases into baseband indistinguishably. Anti-alias removes. Must be analog (preceding ADC). Universal requirement.

derivation_rules.name: oversampling_simplifies_anti_aliasing
derivation_rules.why: Wider transition band. Cheap RC filter sufficient instead of complex multipole. Modern ADCs leverage. Audio: Σ-Δ universal.

derivation_rules.name: STFT_resolution_tradeoff
derivation_rules.why: Heisenberg-like uncertainty for time-frequency. Long window = fine frequency, blurred time. Wavelets adaptive. Fundamental limit.
